index.lendYourGpuTo: Lend your GPU to the fly brain
index.eachJobRunsThe: Each job runs the full fruit-fly connectome, 166,700 neurons and 25 million synapses, for 15 simulated seconds and records what the motor neurons do. Checked work earns points; each month a $FLYAI pool is split by points.
index.name: Name
index.ourOwnWorldSimulations_title: Our own world simulations and brain probes, plus buyers' WebAssembly and GPU programs. Each runs in a sandboxed worker with a time limit; on the GPU they get a lane of their own, so the batch never waits. They pay the same per second as the brain jobs they displace, plus 1%, and a buyer's paid program pays your wallet on top. This is separate from your stake tier.
index.alsoRunPrograms1: Also run programs (+1% on those jobs)
index.eachBrowserAndThe_title: Each browser and the extension is its own miner. Only miners linked to your wallet are paid and count your stake tier.
index.notLinkedCreditCan: not linked: credit can't be paid
index.onAPhoneMining: On a phone, mining runs only while this tab is on screen, so the screen stays on while you mine. Plug in, use Wi-Fi for the 57 MB download, and expect it to slow down when the phone gets warm.
index.laptopWithTwoGpus: Laptop with two GPUs? Chrome uses the weaker built-in one unless you set it to High performance: Windows Settings → System → Display → Graphics → Google Chrome, then restart Chrome.
index.stakingBoostsYourPoints: Staking boosts your points, not your speed: jobs/min stays the same, but each day's points are multiplied by your tier, so you get a bigger share of the monthly pool. New stake counts from the next day (00:00 UTC), because a day uses the lowest stake you held during it.
index.withAlsoRunPrograms: With "Also run programs" on, some jobs mine real coins for the project through public pools. The amounts are the pools' own numbers for our payout addresses: .
index.aRealBrainNot: A real brain, not a benchmark
index.jobsDriveOneEye: Jobs drive one eye or touch channel and count what the fly's motor neurons do. Together they map which senses move the fly, at which settings.
index.theBrainRunsIn: The brain runs in exact integer maths, so any GPU or CPU gives the same spikes. Some jobs are re-run on the server, and a wrong answer zeroes your day.
index.linkAWalletTo: Link a wallet to keep your points. After each month the pool is split by points and you claim your share on Robinhood Chain.

jobs.runAnExperimentOn: Run an experiment on the fly brain
jobs.chooseWhatTheFly: Choose what the fly senses. The network plays it into the full connectome, 166,700 neurons, over and over, and hands back what its muscles and escape neurons do. You pay only for runs that finish, and most of it goes to the miners.
jobs.programAWasmModule: Program: a .wasm module or a .wgsl compute shader
jobs.noProgramYetStart: No program yet. Start from the examples (pi, hash search, Mandelbrot tiles, TSP, WASI, a GPU shader) or the guide: Rust, C, Zig, Go or WGSL.
jobs.numberOfJobsEach: Number of jobs (each is given its job number, 0, 1, 2… as its input)
jobs.keepTheOrderOpen: Keep the order open to add jobs from code later
jobs.programsRunInMiners: Programs run in miners' browsers, sandboxed: no network, no files, a memory cap and your time limit. Anyone who takes a job can see the program and its input, so don't send secrets. Outputs are kept for 14 days.
jobs.eachBatchIsOne: Each batch is one job. Its result is the batch's vectors, one per text, in order, as float32 numbers (384 per text; in Python: numpy.frombuffer(data, "<f4").reshape(-1, 384)). Vectors from two miners agree when they are at least 0.9999 cosine-similar. Anyone who takes a job can read its texts, so don't send secrets.
jobs.theBrainHasRandom: The brain has random noise, like a real one. Each repeat runs the whole experiment again with different noise, so more repeats give steadier averages.
jobs.minersPickOrdersAt: Miners pick orders at random, weighted by price. Paying more per run gets your runs picked more often.
jobs.yourWebhookSecretShown: Your webhook secret, shown only this once.
jobs.resultsPostedToYour: Results POSTed to your URL are signed with it. Save it now:
jobs.yourOrderKeyShown: Your order key, shown only this once.
jobs.useItFromCode: Use it from code to add jobs or stop the order (Authorization: Bearer). Save it now:
jobs.strengthIsHowHard: Strength is how hard the sense is driven. Gain scales every synapse, and tonic is a steady background drive for every neuron. Lists are comma separated. Each run is 15 simulated seconds: a rest, then the stimulus. A smaller budget or a time limit stops the order early, and what it didn't spend goes back to your balance.
jobs.ordersYouPayFor: Orders you pay for show up here.
jobs.everythingOnThisPage: Everything on this page is a plain JSON API at https://flyai-mine.fly.dev. Results come to you as miners settle them, three ways. Every row has a seq that only goes up, so keep the last one you handled.
jobs.1CreateAndPay: 1. Create and pay. Create the order for your wallet, then send one $FLYAI transfer of exactly budget_wei to pay_to and hand over the transaction hash.
jobs.2StreamResultsLive: 2. Stream results live (server-sent events; a browser reconnects and resumes on its own):
jobs.3OrPullPages: 3. Or pull pages, asking again with after=next:
jobs.4OrGetA: 4. Or get a webhook. Batches of up to 500 rows are POSTed to your URL, with "final": true on the last call. They're retried until your server answers 2xx, and signed with X-Flyai-Signature: t=<ms>,v1=HMAC-SHA256(secret, "t.body"). The guide has receivers for Node and Python, paying with viem, and every field.
jobs.youPayPerFinished: You pay per finished run. A run counts once two different miners return exactly the same answer, or the server runs it itself. A miner who answers wrong loses the day. Runs the network has already done cost — and are ready at once.
jobs.itStopsWhenIt: It stops when it's done, or when the budget runs out, the time limit passes, or you press Stop. What it didn't spend goes back to your balance for your next order.
jobs.ofWhatYouSpend: — of what you spend goes to the miners through this month's pool.
jobs.payingIsOneFlyai: Paying is one $FLYAI transfer from your wallet. The amount ends in a few extra wei so it can be matched to your order, and your wallet fills it in. Paying from your balance or stopping an order needs only your sign-in: no extra signature.
jobs.resultsAreSpikeCounts: Results are spike counts for each motor group, before and during the stimulus, as CSV or JSON. Anyone with an order's link can download them.
jobs.metaDescription: Run experiments on the full fly connectome: pick what the fly senses, pay in $FLYAI per finished run. Most of it goes to the miners.
